items.title: Apple Warns Older iPhones Vulnerable to Coruna, DarkSword Exploit Kit Attacks
items.description: Apple is urging users who are still running an outdated version of iOS to update their iPhones to secure against web-based attacks carried out via powerful exploit kits like Coruna and DarkSword. items.title: Russian APT Exploits Zimbra XSS to Target Ukrainian Government in ‘Operation GhostMail’
items.description: A Russian state-linked threat actor has launched a targeted cyberattack against a Ukrainian government agency, exploiting a cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in Zimbra Collaboration Suite to steal credentials and sensitive email data. items.title: Authorities Disrupt IoT Botnet Infrastructure Behind Record-Breaking 30 Tbps DDoS Attacks
items.description: Authorities have successfully dismantled the command-and-control (C2) infrastructure powering four massive Internet of Things (IoT) botnets. The U.S. Justice Department, collaborating closely with Canadian and German agencies, targeted the administrators and architecture behind the Aisuru, KimWolf, JackSkid, and Mossad botnets. items.title: 54 EDR Killers Use BYOVD to Exploit 35 Signed Vulnerable Drivers and Disable Security
items.description: A new analysis of endpoint detection and response (EDR) killers has revealed that 54 of them leverage a technique known as bring your own vulnerable driver (BYOVD) by abusing a total of 35 vulnerable drivers.
